title: Versets Croises
identity: Vincent Paulet’s Versets croisés is an alto saxophone and piano work, Leduc AL30539. A 2012 pedagogical review describes a three-minute piece blending conservative and avant-garde elements and recommends it for study and Jugend musiziert, at middle-to-upper level in the review’s own classification.
